outputs.name: relayCloseCodes
outputs.type: { readonly protocol: 4400; readonly unauthorized: 4401; readonly idle: 4408; readonly replaced: 4409; readonly tooLarge: 4413; readonly rateLimited: 4429; }
outputs.description: Close codes for relay connections, keyed by reason: protocol 4400, unauthorized 4401, idle 4408, replaced 4409, tooLarge 4413 and rateLimited 4429. It matters whenever a relay connection closes for one of these reasons; `as const` types only these six values as literal numbers, and nothing freezes the object at runtime.

outputs.name: relayHeaders
outputs.description: Request headers of `GET /v1/hosts/{hostId}/connect`, beside `Authorization: Bearer`: `role` is `X-Harness-Role` and `device` is `X-Harness-Device`. It matters wherever that request's headers are set or read, and these are the only two names defined here, each typed as a literal string by `as const`.
